items.title: Union Alpha — API Pricing & Providers
items.claim: Lists slug stealth/union-alpha; free input/output; 262,144 context; 131,072 max output; text+image in/text out; tools/tool_choice; response_format without JSON-schema enforcement; single Stealth endpoint. Says anonymous third-party provider and prompts/completions may be retained but not used for training. Live fields observed: P50 latency 14.48s, throughput 13 tok/s, 3d uptime 100%, availability 92.48%.

items.title: Limits
items.claim: Rate limits are separate from credits; /api/v1/key returns free_model_daily_requests when applicable. Docs describe free-model variants as IDs ending in ':' and say provider capacity can also cause 429; headers on platform 429 expose X-RateLimit fields. Does not name Union Alpha or assign it a Union-Alpha-specific cap.

items.title: Rate Limits — What You Need to Know
items.claim: States 20 requests/minute and 50/day for free models, 1,000/day after >$10 purchased credits, and upstream throttles may still apply. It is not a Union-Alpha-specific quota and must not be applied to this slug without confirmation.

items.title: Pricing
items.claim: Free plan shows 50 reqs/day. It is plan-level, not a documented Union Alpha request/token/concurrency allocation.

items.title: API Reference
items.claim: Documents POST /api/v1/chat/completions, Bearer auth, OpenAI-like messages, tools, image_url content parts and response_format.

items.title: OpenCode Go documentation
items.claim: Lists Union Alpha Free, Go model id union-alpha, POST endpoint https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/messages, config id opencode-go/union-alpha, price Free and monthly limit Unlimited (limited time); estimated requests Unlimited. Privacy table says model training Not used and data retention 0 days. It also says Go requires sign-in/subscription and API key; policy may change.

items.title: OpenCode Intro
items.claim: Installation options, /connect, sign-in/API-key prerequisites and basic TUI workflow; OpenCode documents API keys as prerequisite.

items.title: Launch post mirror
items.claim: Post says: Union Alpha stealth model is free for the next week, no data training, built for agentic coding, supports images. It does not give an exact end time or per-day/request/token/concurrency cap.

items.source_type: primary official post, social mirror only
items.title: DeepSWE result announcement
items.claim: Says 'Here’s the DeepSWE result for Union Alpha' and 'Works in every harness'; the accessible mirror does not disclose task set/version, sample count, harness commit, prompt, settings, route, raw run data, or readable graph values. Do not redraw or treat as a qualifying benchmark.

items.title: New stealth model: Union Alpha
items.claim: Large launch discussion. Contains unverified identity conjectures (GLM, Kimi, Mistral, OpenAI, Qwen), claimed tokenizer tests, safety observations, reported loops, slow/stuck responses, and demand for sources/methods. Individual comments often omit prompts/settings; not a benchmark.

items.title: (European) Union Alpha
items.claim: Mistral theory cites the name, 262K context, Spain account association and event timing; countercomments note no proof. Thread includes claimed political-safety outputs and conflicting tokenizer claims; no official attribution.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Reports an hour-long test with 13 tool calls at high reasoning and 70–80 tps; separately says a Monica apt test failed after over an hour and calls it possibly benchmark-optimized. Notes an output-similarity observation to Astra. Prompts, route/settings beyond 'high', and raw traces are missing.

items.title: Profile post
items.claim: Reports Union Alpha sitting for about one hour without visible thinking traces. Image/raw session unavailable in accessible text; client, prompt and route are unknown.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Reports provider errors on OpenRouter and a self-run 'Spidey bench' observation of 70 tok/s and 81% cache hit; no protocol/settings/sample/raw output. Separately repeats a '~74% DeepSWE' claim, which is not a first-hand disclosed benchmark in this source.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Reports OpenRouter errors/slow use; client/prompt/settings/raw errors absent. Must not be interpreted as a platform-wide outage or benchmark.

items.title: Image prompt / GLM identity investigation
items.claim: Claims image-prompt self-identification as GLM/Z.ai, tokenizer 18/18 and a four-task timing run via OpenCode; gives author confidence ranges but accessible material lacks full prompts/raw outputs/harness controls. It explicitly frames conclusion as inference.

items.title: Union Alpha provider comparison
items.claim: Mirrors a single Stealth endpoint and lists speed telemetry/API parameters. It is not an independent quality benchmark and should not be used to identify the provider/model.

items.title: Profile posts
items.claim: Repeats claimed DeepSWE 73% and proposed GLM fingerprint evidence, but accessible post does not supply runnable 26 text/image probes, raw traces, harness settings, scores, or original graph data. Preserve as lead only.
